interpretationUnits.title: Sun in a connected configuration
interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: This theme comes from Sun in House 5 read together with Mercury, using Placidus, rather than from one symbol alone. When the two functions can coordinate, one possible expression is: Marks a supportive geometric linkage that can facilitate coordination when engaged. Domain of creation, experimentation, play, generative output and visible expression. Organizes differentiation, exchange, comparison and transmission of information. Under pressure, the same configuration may make one function crowd out the other; this is an alternative expression to observe, not a fixed trait.

interpretationUnits.relationContext: Sun and Mercury are read in the context of Sextile.
